# [AQUÆDICT-T]{.acronym-literal}: Authentication Technique QM {#authentication-technique-quality-model}

::: {.model-intro .technique}
**[AQUÆDICT-T]{.acronym-literal}** models the quality inherent to an Authentication Technique. An Authenticator Employment determines how authenticators are composed, while the resulting quality is attributed to the concrete Authentication Technique. The quality factors and subfactors are documented in the [**Description**](#technique-table).
:::
